title: Five steps up
subtitle: The five parts of this book, from seeing value to teaching it.

steps.label: See it
steps.note: Value is not in things. It is in people.

steps.label: Create it
steps.note: The job is not to invent. It is to notice.

steps.label: Capture it
steps.note: Creation is abundant. Capture is scarce.

steps.label: Scale it
steps.note: Leverage is doing more with less.

takeaway: Find a real problem. Solve it well. Charge less than the pain it caused.
